summary: Selected EU laws and significant regulatory milestones; sources verified against official EU and Irish authority pages on 9 November 2026. Not comprehensive or real-time legal status. Dates shown are regulatory application, transition or transposition milestones, not automatically client-specific deadlines.

acts.title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
acts.summary: Sets a risk-based EU framework for AI systems and general-purpose AI models, including transparency, prohibited practices and obligations for high-risk uses.
acts.check: Map your role (provider, deployer or other operator); identify covered uses and which application dates apply. The AI Omnibus amended the original timetable.

acts.title: 2026 amendments to the EU AI Act
acts.summary: Amends the AI Act implementation framework, including staggered high-risk application dates and certain transparency transitions. Read alongside the consolidated AI Act.
acts.check: Use the amended application dates, not the unamended 2024 calendar. Determine the specific AI Act provisions that govern your product.

acts.title: Digital Operational Resilience Act
acts.summary: Establishes harmonised ICT risk-management, incident-reporting, resilience-testing and ICT third-party risk requirements for a broad set of financial entities.
acts.check: Check whether your financial entity is within scope and review the Central Bank of Ireland's DORA reporting and ICT third-party guidance.

acts.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation
acts.summary: Introduces EU requirements for crypto-asset service providers and issuers, with earlier application for asset-referenced and e-money token provisions.
acts.check: Determine whether activities involve regulated crypto-asset services, ARTs or EMTs, and distinguish the relevant titles and national transitional arrangements.

acts.title: Cyber Resilience Act
acts.summary: Introduces horizontal cybersecurity requirements for hardware and software products with digital elements, with earlier reporting duties and later main product rules.
acts.check: Assess whether a product or component is covered and whether vulnerability/incident reporting applies. Distinguish the 2026 reporting start from 2027 product obligations.

acts.title: EU Data Act
acts.summary: Sets EU rules on access to and use of data generated by connected products and related services, as well as certain data-sharing and cloud-switching provisions.
acts.check: Identify connected products, data holders, users or cloud services in scope; consider applicable chapter-specific transition arrangements.

acts.title: Directive on cybersecurity across the Union
acts.summary: Sets cybersecurity risk-management and reporting requirements for entities in covered sectors, with national implementation required. EU transposition deadlines and actual national law are distinct.
acts.check: Determine sector, size and national competent authority. For Ireland, review the current Irish transposition status before assuming EU text applies in the same way as a regulation.
acts.special: As of 8 July 2026, the European Commission reported that Ireland had not notified full NIS2 transposition and referred the matter to the CJEU. This note is dated and is not a real-time transposition check.

acts.title: Digital Services Act
acts.summary: Establishes harmonised responsibilities for online intermediary services, including transparency and processes relating to illegal content, with differentiated obligations by service type.
acts.check: Classify the online service and confirm which DSA obligations and possible national enforcement arrangements apply.

acts.title: General Data Protection Regulation
acts.summary: Provides an EU-wide legal framework for processing personal data, including lawfulness, transparency, individual rights, accountability and security obligations.
acts.check: Identify whether you are a controller or processor, which data and purposes are involved, and the relevant lawful basis and obligations.

acts.title: EU securities settlement moves to T+1
acts.summary: The EU is moving to settlement one business day after trading. ESMA identifies operational preparation requirements before the transition date.
acts.check: For relevant investment firms, review ESMA standardised allocation and confirmation messaging requirements and plan testing ahead of T+1.

milestones.title: GDPR begins to apply
milestones.scope: General application date for the GDPR.

milestones.title: Digital Services Act applies generally
milestones.scope: Full general application across EU member states, with certain earlier duties.

milestones.title: MiCA Titles III and IV apply
milestones.scope: Earlier application for asset-referenced and e-money token rules.

milestones.title: Deadline for national NIS2 transposition
milestones.scope: EU deadline for Member States, not proof of full implementation by each country.

milestones.title: MiCA applies generally
milestones.scope: General application date; transitional provisions can depend on national law and activity.

milestones.title: DORA applies
milestones.scope: In-scope financial entities must meet the applicable ICT risk and related requirements.

milestones.title: AI Act bans and AI literacy provisions apply
milestones.scope: First tranche of AI Act requirements.

milestones.title: General-purpose AI model rules begin
milestones.scope: GPAI and governance provisions, subject to applicable transition rules.

milestones.title: Data Act starts applying
milestones.scope: General application date; check chapter-specific and transitional provisions.

milestones.title: AI Act transparency rules and most other provisions apply
milestones.scope: Includes relevant Article 50 transparency provisions; amended dates apply to some other obligations.

milestones.title: Cyber Resilience Act reporting duties begin
milestones.scope: Manufacturers must report certain actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents.

milestones.title: AI Act additional prohibitions and synthetic-content transition
milestones.scope: Specific new prohibitions and transition under Article 50(2) for certain pre-existing systems.

milestones.title: T+1 allocation and confirmation requirements
milestones.scope: ESMA highlights mandatory standardised electronic and machine-readable communication for relevant workflows.

milestones.title: EU securities settlement transitions to T+1
milestones.scope: EU settlement-cycle transition for relevant securities transactions.

milestones.title: AI Act Annex III high-risk requirements apply
milestones.scope: High-risk AI uses listed in Annex III; consult the amended law for transitional details.

milestones.title: Cyber Resilience Act main requirements apply
milestones.scope: Main product security requirements for covered products with digital elements.

milestones.title: AI Act Annex I product-linked high-risk rules apply
milestones.scope: High-risk systems embedded in specified regulated products; consult the amended law.
